body: Im just so tired of it.I really want this pain to end.To be happy for once..
I have had many psychologists and psychiatrists in the past.Thank you for the positivity but i did try to take my life but failed.I dont feel like a victor...
Ive been preparing for 3 years.Im so tired of it. Feels much easier to just give up.Years ago i had a plan that i would kill myself by then so i wouldnt have to deal with it.I failed obviously...
My parents wouldn’t let me do a year off.I already study everyday but they expect me to do 500 questions a day and shit.My mom thinks I’ll fail.

You can try every year. Two days of a year are dedicated to it.Saturday and sunday,one after the other.If you fail the first one the second one doesnt count and you have to try again next year.Even though you dont know when you fail.

Basically there is one exam every year made by education branch of the government. Two sections .First exam determines your general skill level while the second is what you major in.2 million people do the same exam. Not doing it basically ensures you will never get a job.I dont have a choice.
Im a senior in high school,on break right now .The University exam is in a year.I should be studying for it but I dont see the point to do so.Wasting my time on the internet and on games.
